author: IGN
description:
You know what they say, there's truth in beauty… and also in developers reacting to speedruns! In this video, two of the Baby Steps lead developers react to a 7-minute speedrun by asdfgame. Check out real-time commentary from creators Gabe Cuzzillo and Bennett Foddy as they entertain deep philosophical musings while watching this incredible speedrun pushing the game to its limits!

Check out more from the speedrunner, asdfgame!
https://www.youtube.com/@asdfgame3419
title: Baby Steps Developers React to 7 Minute Speedrun

author: IGN
description:
Check out gameplay from Pokemon Champions! This video features 4 ranked matches, three wins one loss. Pokemon Champions is a new free-to-start battle focused pokemon game where you can compete against real life players all over the world. You can build your team by recruting pokemon in game or transferring your favorites from previous titles (and Pokemon GO) via Pokemon Home. Pokemon Champions is currently free-to-start on Switch 1 and 2 and eventually headed to mobile devices sometime in 2026. 

Gameplay captured on a Nintendo Switch 2
title: Pokémon Champions Switch 2 Gameplay: 17 Minutes of Ranked Battles in 4K
